verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a self-hosted Edge Proxy that runs the Flagsmith Engine inside your own infrastructure, with server-side SDKs connecting to it. That keeps SDK flag traffic in-network, and full self-hosting of the platform is also documented as an option. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that flags keep being served when the vendor API is unreachable (caching/failover behaviour), evidence of client-side SDK support through the proxy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
